invariants.rationale: The method always returns 'records', which cannot be null given the method signature requirement.
Both in the empty and non-empty cases, 'records' is sorted in-place and then returned, so 'result' and 'records' are the same reference.
Partition counts are rarely negative; this may be an implicit precondition, though not enforced.
No records are added or removed; only sorted or returned as-is, so size remains unchanged.
Records from input are not changed, so no null entries should be introduced in the output.
